column3: Draw blood on this island and the crew will take you seriously.
The harbour master pays coin for every cutthroat you leave in the sand.
Bone deckhands have crawled out of the old wreck. Send them back under.
A navy patrol is sniffing around the cove. Thin it out before they find the anchorage.
The bone captain holds the old fort. Bring back his skull and the whole cove pays.
Redcoat marines hold the garrison square. Every one you leave on the stones is one fewer musket at the wall.
The garrison officers keep the muster rolls. Take two of them and the reach forgets who is counted.
The cultists ring bells for a village that cannot answer. Silence five of them.
Two acolytes guard the drowned paths. Break their watch for Oduya.
